== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ダース・ベイダー</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">戦闘の際、各戦闘運命数を+1できる（合計に+1ではなく、1回引くごとに+1できる）。彼が操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力+3となる。「ベイダー専用タイ・ファイター」に乗っているなら、戦闘力+4、回避値+3となる。耐：損耗&lt;5。</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">シスの暗黒卿。皇帝の僕。サイバネティック生命維持装置を内蔵した装甲服に身を包む。オビ=ワン・ケノービの弟子であった。銀河一のパイロットであり、狡猾な戦士でもある。</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
AI English reading aid (Memory Core ChatGPT, 7 November 2026).

'''Title'''
<blockquote>Darth Vader</blockquote>

'''Lore'''
<blockquote>Dark Lord of the Sith. Servant of the Emperor. Wears armored clothing with built-in cybernetic life-support equipment. Was a pupil of Obi-Wan Kenobi. The galaxy's foremost pilot and also a cunning warrior.</blockquote>

'''Game text'''
<blockquote>During battle, may add 1 to each battle destiny (not 1 to the total, but 1 for each draw). A starship he pilots gets power +3. If aboard Vader's Custom TIE, it gets power +4 and maneuver +3. Immune to attrition &lt;5.</blockquote>

== Comparison with the original English printing ==
The Japanese game text explicitly explains that the +1 applies to each battle-destiny draw rather than the total and says it may be added; the original English says "adds 1 to each battle destiny." The Japanese condition for the larger [[Vader's Custom TIE]] bonuses says "aboard" (乗っている), while the English says "when piloting." The Japanese lore uses "pilot" and a present-tense description, where the English says "Was the best starpilot in the galaxy."<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" /><ref name="english-original-face">[[:File:Premiere-D-darthvader-decipher-archive.gif|Original English Darth Vader face]].</ref>

'''Original English lore'''
<blockquote>Dark Lord of the Sith. Servant of Emperor. Encased in armor with cybernetic life support. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Was the best starpilot in the galaxy. Cunning warrior.</blockquote><ref name="english-original-face" />

'''Original English game text'''
<blockquote>When in battle, adds 1 to each battle destiny. Adds 3 to power of any starship he pilots. Adds 4 to power and 3 to maneuver when piloting Vader's Custom TIE. Immune to attrition &lt; 5.</blockquote><ref name="english-original-face" />

== Rules ==
The November 1998 [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] states that English is the standard for tournament play, directing foreign-language cards and rules to be played and interpreted as their English counterparts under current rulings, errata and clarifications.<ref name="foreign-language-rule">[[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), p. 62, Foreign-language cards and rules.</ref>
